lead.t: No increased risk (non-proliferative): cysts, simple fibroadenoma, duct ectasia, mild hyperplasia.

b: Ectasia means abnormal dilation. In duct ectasia, the large ducts near the areola become dilated and fill up with thick secretions. This is a degenerative condition, not an infection.
Women in their fifth or sixth decade — older than those with squamous metaplasia
Usually multiparous women — women who have had multiple pregnancies
Not associated with smoking — unlike Zuska disease
